Package hadur2.core.adapt

package hadur2.core.adapt
Recognise, then adapt (S4): the opening book that turns a loaded profile into decisions for the first tick (ADAPT-1, ADAPT-2), the seeds it replays into the KNN views at a lower weight (ADAPT-3), and the trust that fades those seeds when the opponent no longer behaves like its profile (RES-4).

The flow, all driven by HadurCore in a duel:

  1. At the first scan, right after memory.ProfileLibrary loads the profile (MEM-1), OpeningBook.read(hadur2.core.memory.OpponentProfile) reads it once and returns an Opening: the tiers, the first gun (ADAPT-1), whether the flattener starts on (ADAPT-2), the surf prior, the seeds and the starting distance. A tier too uncertain to name gives 1.20's conservative setting (DIAL-1).
  2. A SeedLoader replays the seeds into the gun's and the surf's KNN views, SeedLoader.PER_TICK samples a tick, each sharing a SeedWeight that starts at half a live sample (ADAPT-3).
  3. Two SeedTrusts, one for each seed, compare every new wave's live estimate with the profile's and lower that weight to zero within 20 diverging waves once they disagree (RES-4). The core then also hands the opening's gun choice and surf prior back to live data.

Dependencies

This package reads memory and the model; it never reaches the gun or movement code. The core applies its decisions through their own setters, so gun and movement stay ignorant of profiles.

ArchUnit enforces this (ArchitectureTest.adaptSeesNoClock, tagged DIAL-2): the package may depend only on itself, hadur2.core.memory, hadur2.core.model and the JDK, and never on model.BotInput or model.BotEvent, where the tick and round number live. So no decision here can be conditioned on elapsed time or the round alone (DIAL-2): the book is a function of the profile, and the seed trust counts waves. No gun, movement, KNN, ledger, melee, physics, model or memory code may depend on this package. The core-wide rules apply too: no robocode.* (CORE-1), no randomness, threads, reflection, I/O or clock (RES-6), and no mutable statics (CORE-2).
